news.title: Kay Cee Energy & Infra Limited (NSEI:KCEIL) agreed to acquire remaining 50% stake in Suryavayu Renewable and Energy Solutions Private Limited from Jost's Engineering Company Limited (BSE:505750).
news.body:
Kay Cee Energy & Infra Limited (NSEI:KCEIL) agreed to acquire remaining 50% stake in Suryavayu Renewable and Energy Solutions Private Limited from Jost's Engineering Company Limited (BSE:505750) on March 24, 2026. A cash consideration valued at INR 4.124 per share will be paid by Kay Cee Energy & Infra Limited. Post the Proposed Transaction, Suryavayu Renewable and Energy Solutions Private Limited shall cease to be the Joint Venture.

The Board of Directors of Jost's Engineering Company Limited approved the deal.
